verdict.rationale: No documented training opt-out setting or data-use policy appears in the evidence. A lead can only route around the question: configuring BYOK for every provider means no requests go through the stagewise managed service, and self-hosted models via Ollama or LM Studio mean zero external API calls. Enterprise also offers optional self-hosting of the stagewise Cloud, and a community user reported being unable to find documentation of what data is sent to the LLM. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out control for the managed stagewise Account service, documented data-retention terms, and independent confirmation of data handling.
